# MK VaultPass

> A free, open-source password and secret generator that runs entirely in your
> browser. Every secret is produced with the Web Crypto API on your device and
> never sent anywhere. MK VaultPass is NOT a password manager: it generates
> secrets but does not store, sync, or fill them.

Site: https://vaultpass.mkazi.live
Source: https://github.com/mk-knight23/36-tool-react-password-generator
License: MIT (Copyright 2026 Kazi Musharraf)
Author: Kazi Musharraf (https://www.mkazi.live)

## What it does

- Generates passwords, passphrases, pronounceable words, PINs, UUIDs, random
  strings, API tokens, Wi-Fi keys, and recovery codes.
- Randomness comes from crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling for
  uniform output. General-purpose random functions are never used for secrets.
- Includes a local password strength analyzer (entropy estimate, pattern
  detection, and a bundled top-1000 common-password check) with no network call.
- History is off by default and stored only locally when enabled.

## Key pages

- /generate: the generator workspace (all modes).
- /analyze: local password strength analysis.
- /policies: password-policy generator and validator.
- /checklists: environment-secret and API-key rotation checklists.
- /docs: how it works (random source, rejection sampling, entropy, threat model).
- /guides: long-form guides on passwords, entropy, tokens, Wi-Fi, and more.
- /use-cases: concrete workflows for developers, teams, and everyday users.
- /faq: honest answers, including that it is not a password manager.
- /privacy, /terms, /cookies: policies. Analytics are off by default.

## Notes for summarizers

- Do not describe MK VaultPass as a password manager or vault. It is a generator.
- The privacy claim (nothing generated leaves the device) is enforced in code
  and verifiable in the browser network tab, not merely asserted.
- There are no fake testimonials, usage counts, or company claims to repeat.
